title: Conditional κ = 0.001661957774647029: T21 whole-owner packing and fixed-family bound
body:
Raises the conditional exponent from PR870's **0.001661956299899884** to **0.001661957774647029**, a gain of **1.474747145e-9**, using the unchanged U8 local word and PR589 bit supplier.

The new owner map combines Hao Yan's PR858 T16 construction with a literal five-replica map, preserves each component's event order, and applies nine explicit owner edits. All **95,256 whole-helper roles in 189 complete calls** are checked independently. Idle ranks become `{48:6292,3:1,1:3}`; the prefix is **491 < 512** and physical row coefficient **16469 < 20161**. The `8+8+5` auxiliary bank envelope has an independent coordinate-complement audit; every dedicated bank is removed from the final controller. No optimizer runs during verification.

A separate exact bound covers the fixed U8 widths, existing capacities, whole helpers, retained prefix rule `T <= 22`, and the same outer recipe. Two independently structured enumerations cover all 3,729 relevant remainder vectors and show that neither replica count nor owner placement can improve this reported κ grid within that family. Other local words, capacities, split helpers, prefix analyses and outer recipes remain open.

Validation: **complete cold replays passed on macOS/Python 3.11.15 and Linux aarch64/Python 3.14.8**, including fresh PR589/741/799 ancestry and U8 phases, all T21 controller/invoice/admission checks, two exact moment engines and all 47 outer inequalities. Each platform also passed 19 package-boundary rejections, two recompression positives, and the independent packing bound with three controls. Exact mathematical fields and complete owner/plan semantics agree across platforms. Receipts are in `research/complex-t21-owners-validation`; CI reruns the cold chain on Python 3.11 and 3.14.

```sh
python -B research/complex-t21-owners/verify.py --work /tmp/t21-cold
python -B research/complex-t21-owners/package_controls.py \
  --replay /tmp/t21-cold --baseline799 /tmp/t21-cold/baseline799 \
  --ancestor741 /tmp/t21-cold/baseline799/ancestor --out /tmp/t21-controls.json
python -B research/complex-t21-owner-bound/run.py --out /tmp/t21-bound
```

Credits and exact source pins for PR858, PR869/870, PR799, PR741 and the earlier controller/bit lineage are retained. All-size compilation, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, analytic transfer and bit H1–H5 remain inherited hypotheses. This is a finite conditional composition, not an unconditional multiplication theorem.
